Magpie goose (Anseranas semipalmata) at Kakadu National Park
Three magpie geese fussing over a single chick at Tidbinbilla Nature Reserve near Canberra. The reserve has a fenced wetland but the birds are free to come and go.
Magpie Geese Anseranas semipalmata , Hasties Swamp, Atherton, Queensland. Magpie Geese fly out to nearby farmlands for their evening feed; they will return in a few hours to roost for the night.
